title: Free & Low-Cost Martial Arts Software (2026)
description: Free martial arts school software compared: PushPress, Recess and RhinoFit free plans vs Kicksite, Martialytics, Gymdesk and Zen Planner, with real processing fees.
h1: Free and low-cost martial arts school software
body:
Free martial arts software exists, but "free" usually means someone still pays: either your school pays a higher card rate, your families pay a checkout fee, or the free tier stops at a small student count. We checked each vendor's own pricing page on October 26, 2026 and list only what they publish; anything not published is marked unknown.

{{table:pushpress,recess,rhinofit,kicksite,martialytics,gymdesk}}

Free plans compared

  • PushPress Free: $0/mo with unlimited members and staff, but card payments cost 4.99% + $0.30 (ACH 2.89% + $0.30). Pro is $159/mo with card at 2.89% + $0.30, and Max is $229/mo at 2.75% + $0.30. The pricing page lists Rank Tracking for martial arts academies and invite-only events for belt tests. PushPress pricing
  • Recess: $0/mo per location with one plan and no setup fee, contract or add-ons. Members pay a service fee of about 5% at checkout, and Recess covers card and bank processing out of that fee. Cash or cheque payments you record carry no fee. Belts, stripes, testing and family accounts are included. Recess pricing
  • RhinoFit Start Up: $0/mo if you have 20 or fewer active users in a month (in the US and Canada, also $2,500 or less in payments that month). RhinoFit says free-tier users may have restricted or no access to communications and payment processing. Standard is a flat $57/mo with no member limits. Both include belt and progression tracking. 30-day trial, no credit card. RhinoFit pricing

The processing-fee trap

On a school collecting $5,000 a month by card, the extra fees work out like this (published rates only, ignoring per-transaction $0.30 fees): PushPress Free at 4.99% is about $250/mo in card fees, against about $145/mo at Pro's 2.89%. That $105 gap doesn't cover Pro's $159/mo fee, so at this volume Free still costs less. At around $7,600/mo or more in card volume, Pro's lower rate starts to pay for itself. With Recess, the school pays nothing but families pay about 5% (about $250 on that $5,000) on top of tuition. Standard Stripe processing (about 2.9% + $0.30) on the same volume would be about $145/mo. Check whether a "free" plan still costs less once you add up those fees.

Low-cost paid options

  • Kicksite: $49/mo for 0-25 students, $99 for 26-50. US processing through Basys is a flat $29/mo plus 2.9% + $0.25 per card transaction. First 30 days free. {{aff:kicksite|Visit Kicksite}}
  • Martialytics: $69/mo for up to 50 students with standard Stripe rates and no markup or revenue percentage (per vendor). 30 days free, no credit card. {{aff:martialytics|Visit Martialytics}}
  • Gymdesk: $75/mo for up to 50 active members with Gymdesk Payments ($100/mo with your own processor). The Gymdesk Payments rate isn't published. 30 days free, no credit card. {{aff:gymdesk|Visit Gymdesk}}
  • Zen Planner: from $99/mo (Studio), with staff not charged. It scales by active members at prices it doesn't publish. {{aff:zenplanner|Visit Zen Planner}}

Other free options we found

Two smaller vendors also publish free plans for martial arts gyms. We haven't reviewed them in depth: OLM charges gyms $0/mo, adds a 2% platform fee that members see on each charge, and you pay Stripe processing on your own prices (OLM pricing). MatPilot has a Free plan for small academies at $0/mo plus 2% on payments taken through it, and Pro is $79/mo plus 0.49% (MatPilot pricing).

What we couldn't confirm

Not published on vendor pricing pages: PushPress trial and contract terms, and which plans include Rank Tracking; Recess's exact service fee (it says "about 5%") and attendance details; RhinoFit payment processing rates and parent portal; annual prices for all of these tools; and the Gymdesk Payments and Zen Planner processing rates. MatPilot's Free plan student limit isn't stated.

faq: Is there free martial arts school software?

Yes. PushPress has a $0/mo Free plan (card payments 4.99% + $0.30), Recess charges the school $0/mo while members pay a service fee of about 5% at checkout, and RhinoFit's Start Up plan is $0/mo for schools with 20 or fewer active users. OLM and MatPilot also publish $0/mo plans with a 2% payment fee.
What is the cheapest paid martial arts software?

Of the published prices we checked, RhinoFit Standard is a flat $57/mo with no member limits, Kicksite starts at $49/mo for 0-25 students, Martialytics at $69/mo for up to 50 students, and Gymdesk at $75/mo for up to 50 active members with Gymdesk Payments.
Does free martial arts software track belts?
PushPress lists Rank Tracking for martial arts academies, Recess includes belts, stripes and testing, and RhinoFit lists Belt & Progression Tracking on all plans, including the free Start Up plan.

Not always. PushPress Free charges 4.99% + $0.30 per card payment against 2.89% on its $159/mo Pro plan, and Recess families pay about 5% at checkout. Compare those fees on your monthly card volume with a flat-priced tool before you choose.
